motion.name: motion-gate

motion.name: motion-control

motion.name: reserved-frame-refresh

components.css: .ds-filters{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px;}.ds-filters button{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:18px;min-height:46px;padding:12px 18px;border:1px solid var(--line,#393d34);border-radius:3px;background:transparent;color:var(--foreground,#f4f3ed);font-family:var(--font-body,"Manrope Variable",sans-serif);font-size:13px;font-weight:650;line-height:1.4;cursor:pointer;transition:color 160ms ease,background-color 160ms ease,border-color 160ms ease;}.ds-filters button:hover{border-color:var(--foreground,#f4f3ed);background:var(--surface-raised,#242720);}.ds-filters button[aria-pressed="true"]{border-color:var(--accent-text,#ff8a3d);background:var(--accent,#f26100);color:var(--accent-ink,#121311);}.ds-filter-count{color:var(--muted,#b2b5aa);font-size:12px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;}.ds-filters button[aria-pressed="true"] .ds-filter-count{color:var(--accent-ink,#121311);}.ds-filters button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent-text,#ff8a3d);outline-offset:5px;}@media(max-width:639px){.ds-filters{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));width:100%;}.ds-filters button{justify-content:space-between;padding-inline:16px;}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-filters button{transition-duration:100ms;transition-property:color,background-color;}}

narrative.northStar: A photographic programme for student-built machines and the people behind them.
narrative.overview:
The reviewed redesign uses genuine robot, workshop, and team photography with condensed display lettering and varied editorial sections. Charcoal, orange, and pale neutral text form the default theme; a complete light theme reverses the neutral roles while retaining the team accent. The original logo and full-color sponsor marks remain identity assets.

This record describes the current motion and grid revision: a circular photographic hero that expands across its stage, one Build/Code/Lead workshop sequence, uniform archive and sponsor grids, anchored sponsor tiers, and an orange home invitation. Shared tokens live in src/app/globals.css; route modules define local layouts and MotionSystem.tsx coordinates GSAP ScrollTrigger. The current surface contract is .impeccable/surfaces/src-app-page-tsx.md.
keyCharacteristics: Locally loaded Barlow Condensed headings and Manrope body text.
Equal rectangular frames within repeated image groups, with a circular home hero and bespoke SVG engineering rings.
Theme-aware text, outlines, and controls with persistent light/dark selection.
Real scene selection, decade filtering, and direct contact links.
Native scrolling with bounded photographic motion and a persistent Pause/Enable motion control.

rules.name: Theme Roles
rules.body: Use the semantic text and surface properties when an element changes theme; retain fixed photographic overlays and sponsor grounds where the source explicitly does so.

rules.name: Original Marks
rules.body: Keep sponsor marks in their original colors and use each record's light or dark ground; do not recolor the marks to fit the page.

rules.name: Two Type Roles
rules.body: Use Barlow Condensed for display headings and Manrope for reading and controls; preserve local type size adjustments at narrow widths.

rules.name: Real Frames
rules.body: Keep repeated image groups in equal rectangular frames, retain the authored circular home hero, and honor each season's preserveFrame and position settings so the robot stays readable.

rules.name: Visible State
rules.body: Retain visible keyboard focus, aria-current navigation, and aria-pressed selection alongside the implemented color or underline change.

dos: Do preserve the original logo, team photography, school identity, and complete sponsor recognition.
Do use semantic theme properties and the existing responsive control treatments.
Do retain explicit image framing, readable captions, and reduced-motion support.
donts: Don't recolor sponsor marks or remove their contrasting grounds.
Don't crop away a robot when its source record requests preserveFrame.
Don't present the selective archive as a complete team history or infer a founding date from its first record.
